Speaker: Mira
Text: I used to study the stars from the Cogspire observatory. Every night, charting constellations, calculating trajectories. It was so... orderly.

Speaker: Mira
Text: Then the Rift happened. Now the stars look different from every realm. Nothing is orderly anymore. But maybe that's not entirely bad.

Speaker: Mira
Text: My magic frightens me sometimes. Before the Rift, it was academic — theory, equations, controlled experiments. Now it just... flows.

Speaker: Mira
Text: What if I lose control? What if the starlight decides it doesn't want to listen anymore?

Speaker: Mira
Text: I had a mentor at the Academy. Professor Lendara. She vanished during the Rift — pulled into the Ethereal Realm, we think.

Speaker: Mira
Text: If we find her there... I don't know what I'll say. 'Sorry I couldn't save you'? 'Thank you for everything'? Both, probably.

Speaker: Mira
Text: I've been practicing something new. Weaving starlight into protective wards. It's delicate work — one wrong harmonic and the whole thing collapses.

Speaker: Mira
Text: But when it works... it's beautiful. Like holding a piece of the sky in your hands. I want to show you sometime.

Speaker: Mira
Text: The Rift took so much from all of us. But it also brought us together. I never would have left the observatory if not for this journey.

Speaker: Mira
Text: I'm grateful. For the stars, for the magic, for all of you. Whatever happens at the Fade — we face it together.
